blocks.alt: A person mowing a lawn with a petrol mower on a sunny day

blocks.text: A plot after the season looks worse than it is — usually it is one day of work, not a garden rebuild. We mow the lawn, straighten the hedge, cut and split firewood, and take the branches away so they do not sit in the corner until spring. Trees are priced by size: small up to 5 m and large above that. We do not grind the stump — it stays in the ground, and we say so up front so it is not a surprise. Branch and garden waste removal is charged separately after agreeing the volume.

items: Mowing, clearing the plot and splitting firewood — charged by the hour
Hedges up to 2 m and 2–4 m priced separately, because they are different work
Felling trees up to 5 m or taller: scope and price after assessing the conditions
The stump stays in the ground; the council notice or permit is on you

blocks.text: An initial estimate from a description, photos or video is free. A call-out with basic diagnostics costs 246 zł even without a repair; if work proceeds, this amount is included in its price. Extended electrical fault location is priced separately, from 350 zł. The minimum visit is 246 zł; cleaning has a 250 zł minimum and minimum hours. Travel tops labour up to the minimum; chargeable out-of-town mileage is extra. Unlisted repairs: 199 zł/h. Moving: minimum 2 hours, with the first 80 km of the agreed route included in the van rate. Materials are agreed separately.
